upstream.drop_when: The selected upstream UCM must provide Piano's four-channel speaker PCM with all four amplifier gains, the mono DMIC2/DEC0 microphone route and gain, and jack-detected DisplayPort playback. Verify one physical speaker output and microphone, all speaker paths, microphone enable/disable and DP routing against the matching kernel/topology before replacing the BSP-derived HiFi.conf and its source diff together.

The maintained camera service still uses this portable modprobe invocation while its body is tracked directly in the BSP. Drop when the selected upstream unit resolves modprobe through a distribution-independent path, or when a working native libcamera path removes piano-camerad and its loopback prerequisite. Verify camera service startup on Debian and Arch-based products without requiring /usr/sbin/modprobe.
